answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 67 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in meadow, queued in prism, and trellis publishes the wait time. A farm of 130 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4240 identities would post 2111 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
